g.text: Choose whether this user account can perform administrative tasks.
Standard account (No sudo access) — System changes require root login
: Adds user to the 'wheel' group. Running privileged commands (e.g.
system updates) will prompt for the user's own password.
: The account cannot execute 'sudo'. Administrative changes must be
done by switching directly to root with 'su'.
: Disabled by design for AstraOS security compliance.
